title: State Recovery and Builders
goal: Return ownership on failed typestate transitions and enforce step ordering with builders.

sections.text: You already know how methods consume `self` to transition between types. In other languages, invalid state changes throw exceptions at runtime.

sections.caption: Returning self in Err preserves ownership when a transition fails.

sections.text: When a transition fails, returning `Err(self)` gives the original value back to the caller. This allows retrying without losing data.

sections.caption: Generic parameters track construction state at compile time.

sections.text: You can also use type parameters to build values step by step. Methods like `build` are only implemented on the struct once required fields are provided.

explanation: Return ownership on failed typestate transitions and enforce step ordering with builders.
